lessons.title: KV-Cache Layout Refactor contract drift kills pre_ci (KVPool/MLA family)
lessons.symptom: After upstream [6/N] KV-Cache Layout Refactor (#51718), pre_ci UT fails as a family: dozens of AttributeError in kv_pool/mla/model_runner tests ('MLAAttentionSpec' object has no attribute 'compress_ratio', 'KVCacheTensor' object has no attribute 'shared_by', 'SimpleNamespace' object has no attribute 'layers'), mypy union-attr on the same fields. Killed run 33944487577 step-7 and run 33976675052 step-1.
lessons.root_cause: Upstream standardized the KV cache layout: KVCacheLayout enum introduced; MLAAttentionSpec lost compress_ratio and indexes_kv_by_block_stride, gained tokens_per_state and num_states; KVCacheTensor.shared_by renamed to layers; model_runner_v2 spec attrs built via SimpleNamespace.layers. vllm-ascend overrides AND tests/ut mocks still encode the old contract — fixing one call site per round never converges.
fix_guidance: Follow reference/upstream-contract-drift.md: read the NEW upstream dataclass definitions first, not the failing test lines
Build the old→new table: shared_by→layers; compress_ratio→tokens_per_state (semantics); indexes_kv_by_block_stride→derived from KVCacheLayout; add num_states where state count is needed
rg every old symbol over BOTH vllm_ascend/ and tests/ut/ — the mocks encode the old contract too
Fix top-down: definitions → constructors → call sites → test mocks
Verify with the ut_verify loop on the failing files (--tb=long) instead of waiting for pre_ci
lessons.example: FAILED tests/ut/python/kv_pool/test_kv_pool.py::test_x - AttributeError: 'MLAAttentionSpec' object has no attribute 'compress_ratio'

lessons.title: step-1: pre_ci fix needed (format, mypy, ut)
lessons.symptom: pre_ci failed on format, mypy, ut with 70 violation(s); recovered on a later attempt. First violations: ruff check..................................................................Failed | - hook id: ruff-check | - exit code: 1
lessons.root_cause: The initial adaptation passed analysis but failed mechanical checks (format/mypy/UT) — usually an upstream contract drift whose call sites/tests were not all updated, or a format/mypy rule violated while editing. See the violation lines.
fix_guidance: Classify first: <=3 violations = fix the exact file:line; a family (>3 violations in one subsystem) = an upstream contract change — read reference/upstream-contract-drift.md and fix the whole family (grep ALL call sites, vllm_ascend AND tests/ut)
Verify with the closed loop: run the failing UT files via ut_verify (venv_python from pre_ci_check.json) instead of editing blind
mypy last: contract-aligned code makes most mypy errors vanish on their own

lessons.title: test_whisper NPU OOM at engine init after KV-Cache Layout Refactor (audio/multimodal state not profiled)
lessons.symptom: tests/e2e/pull_request/two_card/test_vlm.py::test_whisper (openai-mirror/whisper-large-v3-turbo, ~1.6GB weights) dies during EngineCore init with torch.OutOfMemoryError: Tried to allocate 6.67 GiB (NPU 0; 61.27 GiB total; 54.89 GiB already allocated). Reproduced in every e2e round of run 34018086282. First visible 09-06: the asset was missing in all prior runs (env_flake), so the engine never started before — this OOM is a real adaptation target, not an environment flake.
lessons.root_cause: Memory profiling sizes the KV cache to ~55GB of the 61GB HBM before the audio/multimodal (encoder cache / Whisper states) allocation runs; the 6.67GiB audio allocation then has no room. Suspected interaction with upstream [6/N] KV-Cache Layout Refactor (#51718): audio/multimodal state (KVCacheLayout-era per-state buffers) is not accounted during vllm-ascend's determine_available_memory / profile_run path, so profiled memory leaves no headroom for it.
fix_guidance: Do NOT classify this as env_flake: the engine reached init and OOM'd deterministically — it needs a code fix

Check how audio/multimodal states are registered after #51718: grep tokens_per_state / num_states / encoder cache registration in vllm_ascend and compare with upstream's determine_available_memory accounting
Likely fix family: include audio/multimodal state size in the profiled-memory budget (or cap gpu_memory_utilization for audio models) so the 6.67GiB allocation has headroom
Verify with test_vlm.py::test_whisper on e2e; UT-level: any kv_pool/audio state tests under tests/ut
lessons.example: run 34018086282 step-1 e2e: test_whisper OOM in all 3 rounds, 6.67 GiB requested / 54.89 GiB already allocated / 61.27 GiB total; gemma4 (49GB cached) also memory-wait-hung the same runs.
